Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Men's versions of women's mods, overlays lined up on men's chests, and part toggles that work

Body size (every size)
- Women's legs made on a nude body (LavaBod+, nude Bibo+) now get men's TBSE legs, fitted to TBSE's Gen A
  legs when the SFW ones don't match.
- A women's mod's shoes and gloves now get men's versions too, instead of being left out.
- New "Made on" choice: tell Proteus which body an old mod was made for (one made before Dawntrail, say),
  and the sizes it couldn't work out by itself are made from that body.
- When nothing was added, the result says why, instead of claiming the mod already has every size.
- Saving the men's legs after the top no longer switches a player wearing TBSE over to TBSE-X.

Refit
- "Refit for" now offers Midlander M on the game's own women's legs.
- "Refit for" a race the mod already has a model of is no longer refused; it warns that the refit takes that
  model's place while it's on.
- A refit for another race or sex is refused when it would keep skin the new body doesn't use. This crashed
  a male Viera wearing women's legs.
- Men's legs refitted from women's legs made on a nude body are no longer invisible.
- Dresses refitted onto bodies with deeper curves (Codeine onto Muse+) no longer show slits of missing skin
  on the thighs. Refit them again to fix ones made earlier.
- A garment made of two parts that meet at the waist no longer splits into a line there when you move.

Overlays on men
- Women's overlays on men, and women's tops refit for men, sat about 3 cm low on the chest. The new body maps
  line the nipples up; they download by themselves. Refit a women's top again to get the new fit.

Imports
- Imported packs that hide and show parts through their options (TexTools-style) now really hide and show
  them, and keep the choices you had set on the installed mod.

Glamourer
- Updated to Glamourer's current release.

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.
